dogecoin.text: Apparently a punishment/side effect for mentioning the word Dogecoin in tweets yesterday is that all the ads in my Twitter feed are now some form of a crypto provider hyping Dogecoin.
How is it that there are people who have no idea what a loaf of bread or a gallon of milk cost but can quote the overnight high of Dogecoin to 6 decimal places?
Will @elonmusk appearing on #SNL tonight help push Dogecoin to the long sought $1 target by next week?

I have to admit it has been fun watching Dogecoin frenzy going into Elon Musk's appearance tonight on SNL. Someone told me today they believe future Dogecoin and crypto charts will have an asterisk marking the event. #ElonDogeSNL
